en.Essa flor tem três metros e fede a carne: This flower is three meters tall and smells like rotting meat! And the last fact is the worst.
en.É a flor-cadáver, da ilha de Sumatra. Se: It's the corpse flower, from the island of Sumatra. Follow Maia, it gets worse: the stench attracts flies and carrion beetles.
en.Pra espalhar o cheiro, ela esquenta sozi: To spread the smell, it heats itself up, almost to human body temperature.
en.E o pior: ela pode levar anos pra florir: And the worst part: it can take years to bloom, and the open flower lasts just one or two days.
